The '''GPE-7300''' was sturdy and fast [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] built by [[Galactic Power Engineering/Legends|Galactic Power Engineering]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Azlyns_ship_land.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A GPE-7300 in landing configuration.]]

The freighter had two oversized engines that were mounted on the bottom of the ship. This provided excellent atmospheric thrust and high speeds in space. The body was boxy and not very aesthetically pleasing, but efficient. The ship did not have high cargo capacity, and was more of a long-range shuttle than a true freighter.<ref name="LECG" />

It landed perpendicular to the ground which allowed it to use its primary thrusters for lift and reduced the strain on the repulsorlift engines. The cockpit was at a 90 degree angle compared to the rest of the ship.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The GPE-7300 followed the [[Galactic Power Engineering/Legends|Galactic Power Engineering's]] designs for [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] and was designed by the same engineers that created the [[GPE-3300 airspeeder]]. It was often used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who didn't need large cargo carrying capability. [[Azlyn Rae]] used one such ship to track down [[Cade Skywalker]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]].<ref name="LECG" />
